response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), s AS (SELECT powerstatus, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_telescopes, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM s, a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
